name: LiNkzr
description: LiNkzr is a Twitch streamer and former professional Overwatch esports player who became a regular participant in [VRChat](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/VRChat) roleplay. He is known as a fixture of [The Golden Gator](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/The_Golden_Gator) community, taking part in improv RP scenes and community game shows alongside other streamers.
